reviews.comment: He's an above average lecturer, and HWs/Exams are pretty fair. Content isn't too challenging. Course was disorganized at some points, and sometimes a little ambiguous with instruction intentionally. I never had any issues with him personally, but he is pretty rude, and sometimes it seems like he takes joy in watching his students struggle/fail.
He's alright but attendance is mandatory. Exams I felt like were graded on the harder side but not the worst. Final is open note though.

Professor Rahmani is a great prof. I took his summer CHEN 205 course, and he was very engaging during the long 2-hour lectures. There were 2 midterms and a final for 25% each, group HW for 10%, online quizzes for 10%, and class assignments for 5%. He gives LOTS of extra credit: 5 points on midterms and 15 on final. I would definitely recommend him!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He is a caring professor. Class participation questions each class - attendance is mandatory. Weekly group homework that isn't difficult. 2 exams + final + group case study project. He gives minimal exam partial credit and doesn't return exams. He's accessible out of class and answers emails almost immediately. Exams are similar to lecture examples

I took him for 312 and it was not pleasant but he was a lot better for 430. He's very dismissive and quite rude, but I think that's just how he is, I don't think it's personal. He mentioned in 1 class that he changed the time of the final exam, and didn't send an email. So half the class came late. But overall he made the class easy.

Dr. Rahmani is an ok lecturer, but a fantastic professor in terms of accommodating student needs and providing opportunities to receive partial credit. He is very knowledgeable and encourages learning by interacting with students in the classroom.

I would not recommend. Lectures consist of him just reading slides, but attendance is mandatory since he does random in-class assignments that count for 10% of the grade. He is nearly inaccessible outside of class and works in his office with the door closed and won't answer if you knock. Exams aren't horrible, but they certainly aren't easy.

CHEN 430 during Fall Semester. Prof Rahmani provides great lectures. Homework done in groups. Final project is fun, try to consult with the prof. Open-note online timed quizzes and random in-class assignments. Exams are very fair, 1 page cheat sheet. Final exam is open-everything. Understand every example from slides & homework problem for exams.
